findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No weak or predictable token/key generation present. _required_secret enforces MIN_SECRET_LENGTH=32 (256 bits) on JWT_SECRET_KEY (line 121) and OTP_HMAC_KEY (line 140) and raises at import when either is absent or too short, so the former short fallback key can no longer apply; nothing is generated in-process from a non-CSPRNG source. JWT_ISSUER/JWT_AUDIENCE are pinned and validated on decode, there is deliberately no JWT_VERIFY_SIGNATURE toggle, and outbound credentials (CDN_TOKEN, DELIVERY_API_TOKEN) default to empty so the integration is off rather than open -- the entropy and non-guessability property ctx.text requires of generated access tokens | verdict=pass confidence=high
